_notes: kind: demo | snapshot | mjpeg | hls | rtsp
country: ISO-3166 alpha-2. Decides which jurisdiction policy gates this camera.
authorization: written | tos-permits | personal-use | unreviewed | prohibited
Whether the OPERATOR has authorised automated access to this feed. Separate
from, and additional to, country policy - both must pass before a frame is
fetched.
'personal-use' means: terms not read, polling anyway because this is a
private project whose output is not redistributed. That is a RISK
ACCEPTANCE, not a permission. It is only honoured while config.deployment
is 'personal' - set deployment to 'published' and every personal-use feed
fails closed until it gets a real basis.
It buys nothing against computer-misuse law. Malaysia's Computer Crimes Act
1997 s.3 and South Africa's ECTA s.86(1) both turn on authorisation, and
purpose is not an element of either offence. What personal use DOES help
with is data protection: POPIA s.6(1)(a) excludes purely personal or
household activity and Malaysia's PDPA is scoped to commercial transactions
- and neither exclusion survives publishing.
interval_s is floored at 20s for non-demo feeds regardless of what you set.
Public snapshot endpoints rarely refresh faster; polling harder just wastes
an operator's bandwidth and gets you blocked.
